players.product: ArF immersion, ArF dry, KrF and i-line semiconductor lithography systems (NSR series), FPD lithography systems and digital lithography systems for advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year to March 31, 2026) consolidated revenue was JPY 677,163 million, down JPY 38,122 million (5.3%) from JPY 715,285 million, mainly on fewer equipment units sold in Precision Equipment; the operating loss was JPY 112,448 million (prior year: operating profit of JPY 2,422 million) and the loss attributable to owners of the parent JPY 86,088 million. Management states results fell far below the initial assumptions, mainly because of impairment losses on non-financial assets in the Digital Manufacturing business.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue JPY 677,163 million (-5.3%); operating loss JPY 112,448 million; loss attributable to owners JPY 86,088 million

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 Precision Equipment segment: revenue JPY 167,258 million (down 17.2%) and an operating loss of JPY 4,565 million (prior year: operating profit of JPY 1,544 million), as unit sales of FPD lithography systems and of ArF dry and immersion semiconductor lithography systems fell. Management states that FPD-related capex stayed firm for both small/medium and large panels, while in semiconductors demand for AI-related chips stayed firm but other devices remained weak.
quarterly_data.figure: Precision Equipment revenue JPY 167,258 million (-17.2%); operating loss JPY 4,565 million

quarterly_data.signal: Precision Equipment order backlog at the end of FY2026 (March 31, 2026) was JPY 112,882 million, up 3.9% year on year (the only segment reporting a backlog; the others mainly build to forecast). FY2026 production value was JPY 402,368 million in total (down 2.5%), of which Precision Equipment JPY 105,574 million (down 0.9%).
quarterly_data.figure: Precision Equipment order backlog JPY 112,882 million (+3.9%); production JPY 402,368 million total, Precision Equipment JPY 105,574 million

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 Components segment (renamed the Industry segment from the company's fiscal 2026, i.e. the year to March 2027): revenue JPY 76,176 million (up 2.8%) and operating profit JPY 9,553 million (up 33.0%). Industrial Solutions grew on firm sales of imaging measurement systems for electronic components and semiconductors; in Custom Products, sales of EUV-related components fell as the EUV-related market slowed.
quarterly_data.figure: Components revenue JPY 76,176 million (+2.8%); operating profit JPY 9,553 million (+33.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 other segments: Imaging revenue JPY 290,053 million (down 1.8%), operating profit JPY 16,715 million (down 59.5%), with Nikon's first digital cinema camera, the ZR, leading sales; Healthcare revenue JPY 111,922 million (down 3.9%), operating profit JPY 1,561 million (down 76.8%); Digital Manufacturing revenue JPY 28,090 million (up 20.3%) on more large machines sold, but an operating loss of JPY 106,282 million (prior year: loss of JPY 15,225 million) after impairment losses on non-financial assets.
quarterly_data.figure: Imaging JPY 290,053 million; Healthcare JPY 111,922 million; Digital Manufacturing JPY 28,090 million, operating loss JPY 106,282 million

quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term management plan 2026-2030 (announced May 8, 2026): targets for the plan's final year (the company's fiscal 2030, i.e. the year to March 2031) of revenue JPY 1 trillion, operating profit JPY 80 billion, company-wide ROIC 7% and ROE 10%. Digital Manufacturing and Precision Equipment are the businesses that aim to maximize corporate value by investing actively in promising markets and differentiated areas; the growth businesses named are digital cinema cameras, large metal 3D printers, and semiconductor lithography systems / digital lithography systems. Capital allocation is up to JPY 800 billion, 90% of it to growth investment. Management states the previous plan (2022-2025) reached its JPY 700 billion revenue target in more than one fiscal year but fell far short on operating margin and ROE.
quarterly_data.figure: company's fiscal 2030 targets: revenue JPY 1 trillion, operating profit JPY 80 billion, ROIC 7%, ROE 10%; capital allocation up to JPY 800 billion

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 capex totalled JPY 59,803 million (Precision Equipment JPY 9,723 million). The capex plan for the year to March 2027 is JPY 75,000 million (new and expanded facilities), to optimize production capacity and maintain and renew equipment; Precision Equipment JPY 13,000 million for new-product production and equipment maintenance and renewal. R&D investment of JPY 73.5 billion is planned for the year.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex JPY 59,803 million; FY2027 capex plan JPY 75,000 million (Precision Equipment JPY 13,000 million); R&D plan JPY 73.5 billion

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D investment (including capitalized development costs) was JPY 77,195 million, of which Precision Equipment JPY 21,622 million. Precision Equipment developed and began taking orders for the ArF scanner NSR-S333F, which the company says achieves industry-leading overlay accuracy with high productivity; it is developing the alignment station Litho Booster 1000; it developed and began taking orders for the DSP-100 digital lithography system for advanced semiconductor packaging (high resolution, large substrates); and it developed and began taking orders for the Gen 8 FPD lithography systems FX-88SL / FX-88SLD, which the company says are the first FPD lithography systems with a UV-LED light source.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D investment JPY 77,195 million; Precision Equipment JPY 21,622 million

quarterly_data.signal: Material contract: Nikon holds a mutual technical assistance (cross-licence) agreement with ASML Holding N.V. (Netherlands) and Carl Zeiss SMT AG (Germany) granting patent licences on lithography systems and digital cameras, running from February 18, 2019 to February 18, 2029.
